name: Clone (copy-move) detection
corpus: six real photographs from the scikit-image sample data (astronaut, coffee, chelsea, rocket, motorcycle_left, motorcycle_right), each manipulated at seeded random places; 60 cases per condition

detection.task: Was an area of the image copied to another place in it (square of 18% of the short side)?
detection.positives: 60 images, each manipulated four ways (see true_positive_rate_by_condition)
detection.negatives: the same 60 images untouched, as given and re-saved at JPEG 85
detection.detected_means: the box around one side of a reported copy covers at least 30% of the pasted square

known_failure_modes: Repeated patterns in the scene (tiles, windows, fences, text, logos, symmetric objects) produce genuine matches that are not edits.
Copies into or from flat, textureless areas (sky, walls) carry too few features to be found.
Strong blur, noise or low-quality JPEG applied to the copy, or a copy smaller than about 30 x 30 pixels, is usually missed.
Only copies within one image are found: an area pasted from another photograph needs the noise map, ELA or double-JPEG analyses.
how_to_reproduce: python -m forensic.validation run --only phase4 --pristine <folder with those six images>
